title: Turbo Circuit
logline: Race a hover-car through a floating neon circuit — hit boost pads, drift corners, and beat your best lap time.
visualStyle: Futuristic low-poly. Track floats in dark sky with stars. Dark gray surface with neon edge lines (cyan left, magenta right). Hover-car: green low-poly wedge. Boost pads: yellow glow. Barriers: orange. Checkpoints: green arches. Fog for depth.
coreMechanic: Hover-car on closed-loop track. Accelerate (W), brake (S), steer (A/D). Track is connected segments (straight + curved). Barriers bounce and slow car. Boost pads double speed for 2s. 3 laps, best time is the goal. Target time decreases per race.
progression: Race 1: No time pressure. Race 2: Beat 60s. Race 3+: Target -5s/race. Obstacle placement increases.
scoring: Lap time (lower = better). +100/checkpoint, +500/lap, -200/barrier hit. Best total time across 3 laps.

screens.intro: TURBO CIRCUIT chrome/neon title. Camera orbits track. Car visible. WASD to Drive. Best time. Click to Race.
screens.hud: Lap time center-top, LAP 1/3 top-left, Speed bottom-left, Best time top-right.
screens.pause: PAUSED overlay with current lap and time.
screens.gameOver: RACE COMPLETE or TIME OUT. Lap times (fastest highlighted), total, stats. Race Again.
